REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 23, 2015 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
JULY 23, 2015 IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Councilmember Jim Edwards.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Boy Scout Troop 394.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Eyesite Optometry (Business Spotlight)

  Raul Cerda, Joesph and Mary La Riccia, and David Elmer and Cheryl Ann Driscoll
  (Citywide Pride Grand Prize Honorees)

5B.  Appointments

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Pulido, to approve Councilmember
  Solanki’s nomination of Candace “Candy” Yee to the Let Freedom Ring Committee, for a two
  year term to expire on March 31, 2017 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk, administered the Oath of Office to Candace “Candy”
  Yee.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Ray, to approve Councilmember
  Edwards nomination of Tiffany Mitchell to the Let Freedom Ring Committee, for a two year
  term to expire on March 31, 2017 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk, administered the Oath of Office to Tiffany Mitchell.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  None.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one

  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 23, 2015
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register of
  Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 23, 2015 in the total amount of

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of July 9, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration of a proposal by the ABC Unified School District to modify
  parking lot traffic circulation and the drop off zone for Mary Bragg Elementary School
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Assistant City Engineer.  A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments and the public
  hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to approve the project
  proposal by the ABC Unified School District to modify parking lot traffic circulation and
  the drop off zone for Mary Bragg Elementary School (COUNCIL). The motion carried
  (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8B.  (continued)

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING AN UPDATED RENEWABLE
  ENERGY RESOURCES PROCUREMENT PLAN FOR THE CITY OF CERRITOS ELECTRIC
  UTILITY (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Assistant City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments and the public
  hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Pulido, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Resolution No. 2015-20, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING AN UPDATED RENEWABLE ENERGY
  RESOURCES PROCUREMENT PLAN FOR THE CITY OF CERRITOS ELECTRIC
  UTILITY (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen

  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of executing enabling agreements with various natural gas
  suppliers for the Magnolia Power Project (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Assistant City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute NAESB agreements with
  qualified suppliers to acquire natural gas for the purpose of providing fuel to generate
  electricity at the Magnolia Power Plant, and
  2. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute confirmations under the
  NAESB agreements for natural gas transactions (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
